data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate has applied a similar approach at current year end to that applied at the previous year end in establishing the technical provisions for claims outstanding reserves and reinsurers' share thereof. Included within net claims incurred of GBP 121,917k (2015 - GBP 99,481) is a deterioration of GBP 6,859k (2015 - deterioration of GBP 29,646k) to the claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to adverse developments in prior year reserves on the Treaty class.

data.standardized_narrative: On a gross basis the syndicate's prior-year claims reserves showed a small net strengthening of approximately GBP 2.95m. The Managing Agent notes adverse/strengthening movements at a portfolio level (with narrative calling out adverse development on the Treaty class), but the gross claims development triangle indicates mixed movements by underwriting year with net adverse movements in some years more than offset by favourable development in others, resulting in an overall small gross strengthening. Named 2016 catastrophes materially affected current-year results but the prior-year movement is driven by claim development across older underwriting years.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 121,917k (2015 - GBP 99,481) is a deterioration of GBP 6,859k (2015 - deterioration of GBP 29,646k) to the claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to adverse developments in prior year reserves on the Treaty class.

The losses on the 2015 and 2016 years of account are driven by new catastrophe and large losses in the year, primarily on the Property, Special Lines and Treaty classes, and attritional loss development on the Property and Personal Accident & Sickness lines.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year development was not explicitly stated as a single gross figure in the movement note (the narrative quoted a net deterioration). The returned gross PYD (GBP 2.951m) is calculated from the gross claims development triangle (note 20). The narrative provides a net prior-year deterioration (GBP 6.859k) after reinsurance - differences between gross and net are expected. No explicit gross aggregate prior-year movement line was found.
